title: Kusanagi Nene — Everything, Even Sorrow〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's the final day for the park's anniversary show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Once it's over, we probably won't be doing any shows here for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hm? Kusanagi, you're here early...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Seiryuin.
Um... Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's nice today, isn't it? The perfect weather for our final showing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, Seiryuin...?
Thanks for agreeing to help us with our show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I mean, this is the least I can do to ensure that Phoenix Wonderland's anniversary show serves as a proper celebration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm going to practice for a bit since we won't be starting for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I...!
I'm really glad that I got to meet an actress like you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought you were amazing when we first met during the show contest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it felt like I got whacked upside my head when I saw your phoenix...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It honestly felt like we were on completely different levels...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just like you said, I was trying to figure out my role all on my own that time, and I kept telling myself that I had to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But in the end, I had to ask you and Ms. Kazamatsuri for help... Emu and the others also played a pretty big role...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You taught me that I still have a lot of work left to do, and I'm really grateful that you did.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Then, you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There are still a ton of things that I need to learn about and figure out how to do...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And it's going to take a lot of time and practice to get it all down.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: As an actress, Seiryuin, I don't want to keep falling behind you! I want to learn how to steal the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, you better be ready for me!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe. What a cute declaration.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, wanting to simply steal the spotlight means you're still thinking of yourself as a supporting character. All you're doing is putting your vigor to waste.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Instead, you should be thinking more about stealing the lead from me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Because you won't stand a chance against me unless you try at least that hard.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: And don't even think about trying to turn tail and run.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I won't!
Don't think you'll get to be the lead so easily the next time we do a show together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And thanks for listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm really glad we got to talk.
I'd been meaning to tell you my intentions.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Likewise. It was nice to hear that you're so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Now, allow me to say this as just Sakurako...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Go. As far as you can. As high as you can.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Because the sky is the limit for you and your troupe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
For everything you've done.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is goodbye for now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But let's do another show together someday.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, I'll very much be looking forward to that day.
